reason: My problem is that I freeze when I have to speak on my own, not that I mispronounce words, and reading a prepared text aloud doesn't fix that. I'd take the 7-day trial and then stay on the free 3 fragments a day, which fits into my evening plan anyway.
objection: It only checks pronunciation of text I read, but in IELTS Speaking I have to answer without a script, and $4.99 a month in dollars through the App Store is a lot of soms for something my family would ask me to justify.
would_change_my_mind: If it let me answer a question freely without a text and still scored me, or if the price were shown in soms at around 200-250 som a month.
